primaryReader: Mechanism designer / behavioral economist / market architecture researcher
readerProblem: Treating participant agreement as binding commitment without structural dissolution rules or downside risk protection.

propositionLedger.statement: Ratification is an alignment signal, not an unconditional binding commitment.
Premature binding commitment shifts dissolution risk entirely onto vulnerable individual participants.
Valid market formation requires explicit dissolution protocols that restore participant outside options at zero penalty.

outsideOptionDependencies: Guaranteed outside option preservation until binding execution
prohibitedInterpretations: Do not claim commitment is universally harmful or undesirable.
Do not specify proprietary cryptographic escrow mechanisms.
claimBoundary: Theoretical framework at Evidence Level E0. No claims regarding live consumer contract enforceability.
handoff: Hands off constitutional coordination rights formulation to Module 05.
